summary: Autonomix Medical, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events on July 28, 2026, disclosing its cash balance of approximately $5.1 million and shares outstanding of 971,043, including shares from a recent warrant inducement on July 13, 2026. This is a routine financial update and does not announce any special situation transaction. No deal terms are provided, as there is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event. The filing is purely informational about the company's current financial status.
